"""
Project Title: Transformer-XL Language Model with Relative Positional Encodings (ai-ml-ds-TXLWiki2025)
File Name: transformer_xl_language_model.py

Short Description:
Implements Transformer-XL in Keras for long-context language modeling on WikiText-2.
Features segment-level recurrence, relative positional embeddings, caching for inference,
and text generation example use cases.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# =========================
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# =========================
SEED: int = 42
tf.random.set_seed(SEED); np.random.seed(SEED)
VOCAB_SIZE: int = 30000    # type: int = vocabulary size
D_MODEL: int = 512         # type: int = model dimension
D_HEAD: int = 64           # type: int = head dimension
N_HEADS: int = 8           # type: int = number of attention heads
D_FF: int = 2048           # type: int = feed-forward dimension
N_LAYERS: int = 6          # type: int = number of layers
SEG_LEN: int = 128         # type: int = segment length
MEM_LEN: int = 128         # type: int = memory length
BATCH_SIZE: int = 16       # type: int = batch size
EPOCHS: int = 10           # type: int = training epochs
LR: float = 1e-4           # type: float = learning rate
LOG_DIR: str = "./txl_logs/" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# =========================
# 2. Relative Positional Embedding
# =========================
class RelPosEmbedding(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self, length, depth):
        super().__init__()
        self.pos_emb = self.add_weight("pos_emb", shape=(length*2, depth),
                                       initializer="random_normal")
        self.length = length
    def call(self, qlen, klen):
        # slice needed range
        # relative positions from -klen+1...qlen-1
        idx = tf.range(-klen+1, qlen, dtype=tf.int32) + self.length
        return tf.gather(self.pos_emb, idx)

# =========================
# 3. Multi-Head Relative Attention with Recurrence
# =========================
class MultiHeadRelAtt(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.qkv_proj = layers.Dense(D_MODEL*3, use_bias=False)
        self.o_proj = layers.Dense(D_MODEL, use_bias=False)
        self.len = SEG_LEN + MEM_LEN
        self.r_emb = RelPosEmbedding(self.len, D_HEAD)
    def call(self, x, mem, mask=None):
        # x: (B, L, D), mem: (B, M, D)
        cat = tf.concat([mem, x], axis=1)  # (B, M+L, D)
        qkv = self.qkv_proj(tf.concat([x, x, x], axis=2))
        q, k, v = tf.split(qkv, 3, axis=2)
        q = tf.reshape(q, (-1, SEG_LEN, N_HEADS, D_HEAD))
        k = tf.reshape(k, (-1, self.len, N_HEADS, D_HEAD))
        v = tf.reshape(v, (-1, self.len, N_HEADS, D_HEAD))
        # content-based
        AC = tf.einsum('blhd,bkhd->blkh', q, k)
        # positional
        r = self.r_emb(SEG_LEN, self.len)  # (M+L+L-1, D_HEAD)
        r = tf.reshape(r, (self.len+SEG_LEN-1, N_HEADS, D_HEAD))
        BD = tf.einsum('blhd,lhd->blh', q, r[:self.len+SEG_LEN-1])
        BD = tf.reshape(BD, (-1, SEG_LEN, self.len))
        BD = tf.expand_dims(BD,2)
        logits = (AC + BD) / tf.sqrt(tf.cast(D_HEAD,tf.float32))
        if mask is not None:
            logits += (mask * -1e9)
        weights = tf.nn.softmax(logits, axis=-1)
        attn = tf.einsum('blkh,bkhd->blhd', weights, v)
        attn = tf.reshape(attn, (-1, SEG_LEN, D_MODEL))
        return self.o_proj(attn)

# =========================
# 4. Transformer-XL Layer
# =========================
class TXLLayer(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.att = MultiHeadRelAtt()
        self.norm1 = layers.LayerNormalization()
        self.ff = tf.keras.Sequential([
            layers.Dense(D_FF, activation="relu"),
            layers.Dense(D_MODEL)
        ])
        self.norm2 = layers.LayerNormalization()
    def call(self, x, mem, mask=None):
        h = self.norm1(x + self.att(x, mem, mask))
        h2 = self.norm2(h + self.ff(h))
        return h2

# =========================
# 5. Build Transformer-XL Model
# =========================
inp = Input((SEG_LEN,), dtype=tf.int32, name="input")
mem_in = Input((MEM_LEN, D_MODEL), name="memory")
# embedding + positional bias via relative
x = layers.Embedding(VOCAB_SIZE, D_MODEL)(inp)
mem = mem_in
new_mems = []
for _ in range(N_LAYERS):
    layer = TXLLayer()
    x = layer(x, mem)
    # update memory: take last MEM_LEN of concat(mem,x)
    cat = tf.concat([mem, x], axis=1)
    new_mems.append(cat[:, -MEM_LEN:])
# output
logits = layers.Dense(VOCAB_SIZE)(x)
model = Model([inp, mem_in], [logits] + new_mems)
opt = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)
loss_fn = tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True)

# =========================
# 6. Data Pipeline: WikiText-2
# =========================
def build_dataset(split):
    ds = tfds.load("wikitext", split=split)
    ds = ds.map(lambda x: tf.strings.unicode_split(x["text"], "UTF-8"))
    tokenizer = tfds.deprecated.text.Tokenizer()
    vocab = tfds.deprecated.text.SubwordTextEncoder.build_from_corpus(
        ds.as_numpy_iterator(), VOCAB_SIZE)
    def encode(tokens):
        ids = vocab.encode(''.join(tokens.numpy().astype(str)))
        return ids
    # Skip detailed implementation; assume pre-tokenized dataset yielding integer sequences
    # For brevity, pseudo-code dataset producing batches of SEG_LEN+1 sequences
    return ds  # placeholder

train_ds = build_dataset("train").batch(BATCH_SIZE)
val_ds = build_dataset("validation").batch(BATCH_SIZE)

# =========================
# 7. Training Loop with Recurrence
# =========================
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    mems = [tf.zeros((BATCH_SIZE, MEM_LEN, D_MODEL)) for _ in range(N_LAYERS)]
    for batch in train_ds:
        # split into input and target
        x_seq = batch[:, :SEG_LEN]
        y_seq = batch[:, 1:SEG_LEN+1]
        with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
            outputs = model([x_seq] + mems, training=True)
            logits, *new_mems = outputs
            loss = loss_fn(y_seq, logits)
        grads = tape.gradient(loss, model.trainable_variables)
        opt.apply_gradients(zip(grads, model.trainable_variables))
        mems = new_mems
    print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {loss:.4f}")

# =========================
# 8. Example Inference: Text Generation
# =========================
def generate_text(seed_text: str, length: int = 100):
    # tokenize seed_text...
    token_ids = [1,2,3]  # placeholder
    mems = [tf.zeros((1, MEM_LEN, D_MODEL)) for _ in range(N_LAYERS)]
    for t in range(length):
        x_in = tf.expand_dims(token_ids[-SEG_LEN:], 0)
        outputs = model([x_in] + mems, training=False)
        logits, *mems = outputs
        next_id = tf.random.categorical(logits[:, -1, :], 1)[0,0].numpy()
        token_ids.append(int(next_id))
    return token_ids  # placeholder for decoded text

print("Generated:", generate_text("Artificial intelligence", 50))

# =========================
# End of Code
